sources.snippet: Global navigation satellite system reflectometry (GNSS-R) has emerged as a promising technique for global sea surface wind speed measurement. Currently, a lot of methods based on convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have been developed to extract features from delay Doppler maps (DDMs) and retrieve wind speed from GNSS-R data.
